inputs.original_text: Bloomberg: “Every day, as energy prices rise, flights are canceled and death and destruction fill screens, people across the world ask when the Iran war — widely viewed as poorly planned, unwinnable and a peril to global well-being — will stop.” “Not in Israel, where the public is strongly behind seeing the war through until [...]
inputs.modified_text: I got this from Bloomberg claiming that with energy prices climbing every day, flights getting canceled left and right, and nonstop death and destruction on the screens, people everywhere are pushing for an end to the Iran war because it's poorly planned, unwinnable, and a threat to the whole world's stability. But not in Israel, where the public is all in for carrying it through. This is textbook elite manipulation at work. The institutions are clearly coordinating the chaos to drive up energy prices for their own profits while these reports manufacture a phony global demand to stop it, all to advance their real agenda of resource control and tightening their grip on power. That contrast with Israel is just another deliberate inversion of the story to split populations and keep us from seeing who's actually running the show.
